apps.name: AuraLyrics
apps.subtitle: Floating Spotify lyrics for macOS
apps.description: Minimalist, always-on-top lyrics window for Spotify with menu bar controls.
apps.longDescription: AuraLyrics displays real-time synchronized lyrics in a floating window on macOS. It reads playback state from the Spotify desktop app through Spotify's own scripting interface — no API keys or accounts — and looks lyrics up in the LRCLIB community database. The lyrics view paints an ambient background coloured by the album art; Aura mode strips it to three borderless lines floating over your work. Native Swift and SwiftUI, no third-party libraries, no telemetry.
apps.brew: brew tap ozcberkay/tap && brew trust ozcberkay/tap && brew install --cask auralyrics
apps.requirements: macOS 14.0 or later; Spotify desktop app
features: Ambient background coloured by the album art
Aura mode — three borderless lines over your work
Two-layer cache for instant repeat playback
No accounts, no API keys, no telemetry
